output_format.fix: Declare an output contract: an `output:` block with format and destination, either at the top level or nested under `metadata.contract:`. Both satisfy this signal.

frontmatter_completeness.fix: If the detail names tags or discoverability, the fix is a TOP-LEVEL `tags:` list. Tags under `metadata.discoverability.tags` do not count toward this signal, and that is the shape `rote workspace export` generates, so a play can carry nine tags and still be marked down. Keep the discoverability block as well; add the top-level one.
